parties.counterparty: Manufacturers' Services Western U.S. Operations, Inc. (MSL)

plans.note: Primary clause is Base Agreement § 15.3 Limitations of Liability (within § 15.0 Indemnification and Limitation of Liability); read § 15.1/15.2 for interaction with indemnity carve-outs. Separate liability cap/disclaimer appears in the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement § 15 Limitation of Remedies (p1573-p1575), which limits IBM's liability to MSL. Check mutuality, cap size and carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, IP, gross negligence).

MSL indemnity in favour of IBM at § 15.1 (scope) with procedure at § 15.2; exclusions at p0263. Additional MSL indemnity for MS Code at p1359 and audit-cost indemnity at p1448. Also review Loan Agreement § 14 Patents and Copyrights for any IBM-side indemnity. Confirm third-party IP claims are covered and that any IBM reverse indemnity stays narrow.

No non-compete binding IBM located. Nearest hits are the CDA residual/non-restriction language (p1491, expressly preserving freedom to compete), SOW § 14.18 Restrictions and Limitations (integration scope, worth a quick read) and the change-of-control-by-a-competitor termination trigger at p0116. Expect 'no restrictive covenant on Customer'.

No clause obliging IBM to source exclusively from MSL was found; the sourcing provisions run the other way (MSL must buy from IBM Nominated Suppliers on IBM's terms). Workers should confirm §§ 3.0/4.0/6.0 of the SOW contain no requirements-contract language before concluding absent.

Only MFN found is at p1099: MSL engineering priced to IBM on a 'most favored customer' basis — i.e. MFN in our favour; do not flag. Confirm no reciprocal MFN obliging IBM in the pricing sections (§ 7.0 Price, § 8.2 Parts Cost Reductions).

§ 9.0 Personnel p0189 restricts IBM from soliciting Transferred Employees for [*] years without MSL consent, with carve-outs for unsolicited contacts/general advertising. Check duration, scope (Transferred Employees only) and adequacy of the carve-outs against the playbook.

Exit rights are structured as term/non-renewal: Base Agreement § 4.0 (p0104, six months' notice of intent to terminate at renewal) and SOW § 2.0 (p0658, twelve months' notice against six-month renewals — asymmetric and onerous for us). PO-level convenience termination at p0722 (IBM pays cost reimbursements). CDA § 8 p1497 allows either party to terminate on notice. Review § 5.1 Breach and §§ 5.2/5.3 for post-termination cost exposure.

Two auto-renewal provisions: Base Agreement § 4.0 (p0104) twelve-month auto-renewals with six months' notice; SOW § 2.0 (p0658) six-month auto-renewals requiring twelve months' notice — notice window exceeds the renewal period, which merits scrutiny. Also check any price-uplift mechanics on renewal.

§ 16.9 selects New York substantive law, jury-trial waiver and courts sited in New York, plus a contractual limitations period ([*] years) at p0301. CDA § 8 p1499 also selects New York. New York is an accepted law; assess the jury waiver and shortened limitations period in the rationale.

§ 16.2 (p0281) bars assignment/transfer/subcontracting by either party without prior consent — check for an IBM affiliate/successor carve-out. § 16.5 Sale or Merger (p0290) requires MSL notice and successor assumption. Loan Agreement p1578 restricts MSL assignment only (benefits us). p1346 is an MS sublicence restriction on MSL.

Core ownership provision at § 13.1 (p0197-p0198): IBM owns and MSL assigns all IP and inventions relating to Products/IBM processes, subject to MSL's use right — favourable to us. Related: § 13.3 licence-back limits (p0208), consigned inventory/tooling ownership (p0898, p1094, p1107), Loan Agreement § 5 ownership (p1529-p1530) and Attachment 6 Derivative Work restrictions (p1281, p1304). No general 'Customer Data' construct in this manufacturing deal.

Licences here run mainly from IBM to MSL (§ 13.3 royalty-free licence at p0208; Loan Agreement §§ 5-6 at p1530, p1532; Attachment 6/Appendix A restrictions at p1301, p1337, p1346). Since we are the licensor in most grants, check § 13.3 for any licence we receive from MSL (scope for IBM Subsidiaries and contractors, irrevocability) and note the rest as licensor-favourable.

All located audit rights run against MSL (Base § 7.0 process audits; Attachment 6 § 4.0 and Appendix A § 4 additional audits, frequency limit at p1448; consigned inventory/tooling inspection at p0909, p1107; acceptance inspection p1047) — these benefit us. § 16.14 Records is mutual five-year record-keeping. Confirm no audit right exercisable against IBM before concluding compliant.

Delivery-performance payment adjustments and the [*]% penalty run against MSL (SOW § 7.3 and the delinquency tables; Product Recall cost at p1086) — favourable to us, do not flag. The only charge potentially payable by IBM is the PO cancellation charge regime at p0722 (no charge where MSL defaults; convenience cancellations still carry cost reimbursement) — assess that for a disguised termination fee.

MSL product warranty at SOW § 19.1 (conformity, quality, workmanship, free from defect) with duration at p1067 ([*] months) and latent-defect coverage p1068; title warranty § 19.4; implied-warranty treatment § 19.6 (check for disclaimer adverse to us); epidemic failure/recall § 19.7; MSL entity warranties § 14.2; quality commitments § 17. Note the 'AS IS' disclaimers at p0174 (IBM selling assets to MSL) and p1567 (IBM loaned items) run in our favour.

No general vendor insurance article (CGL/E&O/workers' comp certificates) located. Only asset-specific cover: MSL must carry replacement-value insurance on consigned Products with IBM as joint insured (p0909) and joint insured status on IBM-owned tooling (p1107). Treat as missing for the standard insurance package unless a worker finds a broader clause on full read.

No stated minimum purchase volume, but functionally equivalent exposure: on termination IBM must purchase MSL inventory and on-order Parts against forecast, subject to Appendix 4 Supply Flexibility (p0132-p0135, pricing at p0143), plus EOL Inventory § 13.3 and Supply Flexibility § 13.2. Offsetting protection at p0903 (IBM has no liability for inventory MSL buys outside the flexibility parameters). Assess whether the forecast/flexibility mechanism creates take-or-pay without an exit.

§ 5.2 Rights Upon Termination is the main exit clause (return of IBM documentation and confidential material at p0130; IBM purchase of inventory/tooling p0132-p0135) with § 5.3 pricing on termination. Transition Services § 12.0 covers the inbound transition only (through 1998), not exit assistance. Attachment 6 § 3 (p1435) requires return of MS Software Images on termination; § 23.0 disaster recovery is related continuity support. Check whether any obligation to provide exit/migration assistance and knowledge transfer exists.
